ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_WANTED.title: Wanted
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_WANTED.description: At the end of the player turn, the enemy takes damage equal to its [gold]Wanted[/gold] stacks. If killed by this damage, the applier gains 30 Gold. Remove [gold]Wanted[/gold] after dealing damage.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_MARKED.title: Marked
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_MARKED.description: At the end of the player turn, the enemy takes 5 damage once per [gold]Marked[/gold] stack, then loses 1 stack of [gold]Marked[/gold].
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SLUGGISH.title: Sluggish
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SLUGGISH.description: Each stack additively lowers damage dealt by 5% (1 stack: 95% damage; 2 stacks: 90%). Whenever an enemy gains 1 Sluggish, it loses 1 random positive buff. At the trigger threshold, enemies lose that many stacks and become Stunned; the player clears Sluggish and becomes Stunned this turn.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SILENCE.title: Silence
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SILENCE.description: This creature cannot use skills this turn.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SHIVER.title: Shiver
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SHIVER.description: This creature's attacks fail this turn.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_PARALYSIS.title: Paralysis
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_PARALYSIS.description: The next attack fails and consumes 1 Paralysis. Stacks up to 3.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_POISON.title: Poison
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_POISON.description: At end of turn, lose HP equal to Poison, then reduce Poison by 1.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_REGEN.title: Regen
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_REGEN.description: At end of turn, heal HP equal to Regen, then reduce Regen by 1.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_FORCED_EXIT.title: Forced Exit
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_FORCED_EXIT.description: This creature immediately leaves the current combat.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_FEAR.title: Fear
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_FEAR.description: Each stack additively increases damage taken by 10% (1 stack: 110%; 2 stacks: 120%).
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_RECONSTRUCTION_BODY.des: Lasts 1 turn. If another living teammate is present, whenever you heal, all living teammates heal for half that amount. If no living teammates are present, your healing is increased by 50%.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_BLOCK.title: Block
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_BLOCK.description: Prevent damage until the next turn.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SERVANT.title: Servant
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_SERVANT.description:
At the start of each turn, Osty attacks a random enemy for damage equal to its current HP.
Ends when Osty dies.
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_VERDANT_SOIL.title: Verdant Soil
ARK_BASE_KEYWORD_VERDANT_SOIL.descriptio: Prevent one instance of damage. Heal 4 HP when consumed.
